# SeekAPI — product-first China supplier comparison

China Supply Check starts from a product photo or written brief, then compares evidenced matching products from distinct supplier identities. A successful check targets three actionable suppliers; ordinary partials remain provisional. Wrong products and known hard conflicts are not rescued by badges or weak padding.

Selection V2: comparable price45%, scoped sales35%, MOQ fit10%, freshness and active status10%. Missing non-hard evidence scores zero and remains an RFQ question. Deduplicate connected legal business / marketplace member / shop identities; keep one primary offer per supplier and disclose the observed identity level/confidence. Protect at most20 unique suppliers within10 product-score points of the best product. Within the protected pool, select source tiers F5→F0, then product score within a tier. Q1–Q6 is auxiliary trust explanation, not six all-PASS admission gates. Source factory evidence is not an independent SeekAPI onsite audit.

Payment observation: image Stripe hosted Checkout LIVE at USD2.99; image x402 OFF; text/model Stripe OFF; text/model x402 LIVE at2.99USDC on Base. Runtime admission is authoritative: call discover_china_supply_check_v0 before a new purchase. UNKNOWN is not LIVE. Free preparation and editable confirmation come before payment. Existing authenticated order/result reads are free; do not pay again.

- Product: https://seekapi.ai/china-supply-check
- Human example: https://seekapi.ai/china-supply-check/sample
- MCP guide: https://seekapi.ai/for-agents
- MCP endpoint: https://api.seekapi.ai/mcp
- Public contract and payment observation time: https://seekapi.ai/.well-known/csc-commercial-truth.json
- ARD: https://seekapi.ai/.well-known/ard.json
- Agent manifest: https://seekapi.ai/for-agents/agent-services.json
- OpenAPI for public HTTP reads: https://seekapi.ai/openapi.json
- Official Registry latest: https://registry.modelcontextprotocol.io/v0.1/servers/io.github.kiddhu%2Fseekapi/versions/latest
- Discovery and external stale records: https://seekapi.ai/discovery-status
- Sourcing guides: https://seekapi.ai/sourcing

The public example is HISTORICAL_RECONSTRUCTION. Original pool count and weights are NOT_RECORDED; current V2 scores are RECOMPUTED. Three DIRECT_MATCH products have commercial score0/100 and source tierF0: stale or insufficient commercial evidence earns no credit; current factory role is not established. Zero is not a negative product rating, F0 does not mean not a factory, and deterministic tied display order is not commercial superiority. Exact SKU/material/dimensions/quality/stock/lead time/formal quotation require RFQ. No private images, supplier identities, source URLs or complete contact details are public. Contact availability is null when unknown.

Eligible source marketplace product transactions may have observed platform protections. These do not compensate the $2.99 screening fee or create a direct SeekAPI guarantee. Product-level applicability remains bounded by actual source observation.

$19.90 Live RFQ Compare means contact, translation, follow-up and formal quotation comparison, not contact unlock. It is not currently open for purchase; this sample performs no purchase or contact. Public business contacts in authenticated paid results remain readable. Other human desk work requires separately agreed scope, fee, recipients and authority; no autonomous human-task API is live.

Full product-first V2 method: https://seekapi.ai/china-supply-check#selection-method
Product-first V2: comparable price 45%, scoped sales 35%, MOQ fit 10%, freshness and activity 10%. Deduplicate supplier identities, protect at most 20 within 10 points of the best product, then select F5 to F0; Q1–Q6 is auxiliary trust, not six admission gates. Scores 0 and tiers F0 in this historical example do not establish commercial inferiority. Deterministic ties do not establish superiority.
